title: Attendance Cut Measured on an Earlier Prior Authorization Approval
content:
**Ledger rule.** The attendance cut of a transition-of-care request compares the units posted as used on the earlier approval with the units granted on it: where fewer than half of the units granted were used, two units are cut; where at least half but fewer than three quarters were used, one unit is cut; where three quarters or more were used, nothing is cut.

The earlier approval is the member's earlier Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization approval for the same service code on which the transition-of-care request is built. The units used are all use entries posted on it; the units granted are all grant entries posted on it. The cut is subtracted once from the units the transition-of-care request asks for, before the ceiling of the class's most units per approval is applied. The floor of zero is applied once, to the figure that results after the ceiling, and never to the cut taken on its own.

*Hypothetical placement:* where the figure before the ceiling would be 21 without this cut, in a class whose most units per approval is 20, a cut of 2 gives 19, which is under the ceiling, so the request asks for 19 units. Where they would come to 1 without this cut, a cut of 2 leaves less than nothing, so the request asks for 0 units.

## Bands

| Units used compared with units granted | Units cut |
|---|---|
| fewer than one half | 2 |
| one half or more, but fewer than three quarters | 1 |
| three quarters or more | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

With 12 units granted, one half is 6 and three quarters is 9:

| Units used | Band | Units cut |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | fewer than one half | 2 |
| 6 | exactly one half | 1 |
| 8 | below three quarters | 1 |
| 9 | exactly three quarters | 0 |

With 10 units granted, three quarters is 7.5: 7 units used cuts 1 unit, 8 units used cuts nothing.
